name: Qualor
description: Scan the repository with the Qualor scanner image and upload the report to your Qualor server.
helpMarkDown: Needs a Linux agent with Docker and the pipeline variables QUALOR_URL and QUALOR_TOKEN (a secret). [Guide](https://qualor.dev/docs/azure-devops)
author: Qualor

inputs.name: dotnet
inputs.label: Analyse .NET with the MSBuild integration
inputs.helpMarkDown: Runs `qualor dotnet begin`, the build command and `qualor dotnet end` in the `qualor/scanner-dotnet` image. The build gets neither QUALOR_URL nor QUALOR_TOKEN and sees the repository's .git read-only: run tools that write to .git in an earlier step.

inputs.name: dotnetBuild
inputs.label: Build command
inputs.helpMarkDown: The shell command that builds the solution inside the `qualor/scanner-dotnet` image.

inputs.name: imageTag
inputs.label: Scanner image tag
inputs.helpMarkDown: The tag of `qualor/scanner` (or `qualor/scanner-dotnet`) to run. The default is the extension's version.

inputs.name: arguments
inputs.label: Arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Extra arguments of `qualor scan` (or `qualor dotnet end`), for example `--no-wait`.
